request.prompt:
Exact SAME blue crystal golem from both references: same pointed crystalline head/eyes, massive faceted shoulders, long bulky crystal fists, V chest, stout jointed legs/flat feet, cobalt/sapphire and icy-white facets, same detailed painted2D RPG model and isometric camera. Solid blue joint connections keep head, torso, arms, hands, hips and feet attached. No different robot, clothes, weapon, hair or tail. CONSTANT character proportions/physical scale. Alpha ZERO off the complete figures, no particles/debris/fog/floor/shadow, no cropped spikes/fists/toes or neighboring-pose contamination. Broad transparent gutters. Real joint movement, no global rotate/scale/mirror copies.
Exactly EIGHT complete figures in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, eight spacious columns. EVERY figure faces EAST/RIGHT PROFILE at exactly the same camera angle and model size. These are8 ordered phases of a grounded heavy WALK, not8 directions. The near leg/arm means the camera-side limbs, the far limbs must also remain clearly attached/visible. At least one sole or toe supports the ground at every phase, no flight. Phase1 near foot FORWARD RIGHT flat, far foot BACK LEFT, near arm back and far arm forward. Phase2 near knee absorbs weight, near sole stays flat and far toe lifts behind. Phase3 near planted leg passes under hip while far knee/foot swings forward. Phase4 near heel rises behind, far foot descends ahead. Phase5 OPPOSITE SUPPORT: FAR FOOT FORWARD RIGHT flat, NEAR FOOT BACK LEFT toe; near arm now forward and far arm back. Phase6 far knee absorbs, near foot lifts behind. Phase7 far planted leg under hip, near knee/foot passes forward. Phase8 far heel rises behind while near foot descends ahead to phase1. Near-foot-first and far-foot-first silhouettes must actually differ; do not keep one foot permanently forward. Let the heavy arms counter-swing without concealing both legs. Slight pelvis/knee weight shift, no model inflation, hopping or floating. One continuous connected full body per column with generous clear padding. Only8 figures.
